title: paragynoxys corei
intro: Paragynoxys corei, commonly known as the "Tree of life" or "Bitter tree", is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections, due to its numerous health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Paragynoxys corei include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight against infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified in the plant's leaves and roots.
